## Goal

Provide WordPress administrators and developers with an intuitive interface to design, customize, and manage content models and custom post types without coding.

## Scope

- Visual content model builder
- Custom post type creation and management
- Taxonomy and relationship definition
- Template-based content organization
- Model versioning and migration
- Export/import functionality
- REST API exposure

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Visual builder fully functional
- [ ] 50+ pre-built templates available
- [ ] One-click post type creation
- [ ] Relationship mapping supported
- [ ] Migration tools functional
- [ ] API documentation complete
- [ ] Testing coverage > 85%
